[[Sullivan Athletic Center|McGrath–Phillips Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2015–16 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2015–16 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team''' represented [[DePaul University]] during the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They played their home games at the [[Allstate Arena]], and were members of the [[Big East Conference]]. [[Dave Leitao]] returned to [[Chicago]] to lead the Blue Demons for the second time, following a three-year tenure from 2002–2005.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/chicago/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/12581470/dave-leitao-named-depaul-blue-demons-head-basketball-coach|title=Leitao to coach DePaul after 10 years away|date=29 March 2015}} They finished the season 9–22, 3–15 in Big East play to finish in ninth place. They lost to [[2015–16 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the first round of the [[2016 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]]. == Previous season == The [[2014–15 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|Blue Demons]] finished the 2014–15 season with record of 12–20 (6–12 Big East), tied for 7th in the conference. They were eliminated in the opening round of the [[2015 Big East men's basketball tournament|2015 Big East tournament]]. Following the season, head coach [[Oliver Purnell]] resigned{{Cite web |url=http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/25107571/depaul-coach-oliver-purnell-resigns |title=Archived copy |access-date=2015-04-24 |archive-date=2015-03-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150315055722/http://www.cbssports.com/collegebasketball/eye-on-college-basketball/25107571/depaul-coach-oliver-purnell-resigns |url-status=dead }} and was replaced by Leitao. ==Departures== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
